newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American sells land at Bay Meadows.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American sells land at Bay Meadows.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said Monday it sold about 175 acres of land at the Bay Meadows Racetrack in San Mateo, California, in a move that it said should help it focus on its hotel business.
The company said it sold the land under and around the racetrack to PW Acquisitions IV LLC, a Paine Webber affiliate, for $81 million in cash.

As part of the deal, Patriot will retain the racetrack operations and lease the facility under a seven-year ground lease, and the racetrack management will continue to operate the track through Patriot's operating company.
Patriot American said it plans to re-deploy its capital in its hospitality and leisure core businesses.

The sale follows Patriot American's merger with California Jockey Club and Bay Meadows Operating Co, through which the company acquired one of only four paired-share real estate investment trust structures in the country.
A paired-share REIT is comprised of an operating company in addition to the REIT, and through the operating company the REIT is able to operate its own assets.
Non paired-share REITs are required by law to contract with third parties to operate their assets.
